tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps directly to the four-digit tax year printed at the top of the form.

payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName is the primary payer name line; blueprint bundles both name lines into one field but this is the closest single-line match.

payer_street_address.rationale: Blueprint splits payer address into street vs. city/state/zip, but the canonical schema wraps payer address in PayerUSAddress/PayerForeignAddress group elements without exposing individual street/city/state sub-elements in the candidate list — blueprint should be refactored to reference the PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress group sub-elements (AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd) once those are available.

payer_city_state_zip.rationale: Same structural mismatch as payer_street_address — city/state/zip are sub-elements of PayerUSAddress not individually listed in the candidate set; blueprint should split into separate canonical sub-fields.

payer_phone.rationale: PhoneNum at the form root corresponds to the payer's telephone number in the payer address block.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN is the canonical element for the PAYER'S TIN box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the canonical element for the RECIPIENT'S TIN box; the schema uses SSN field for recipient TIN (SSN/ITIN/EIN).

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the RECIPIENT'S name box on the form.

recipient_street_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under RecipientUSAddress corresponds to the street address line of the recipient's US address block.

recipient_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city, state, and ZIP into one string, but the canonical schema splits these into separate sub-elements (CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd) within RecipientUSAddress — blueprint should be refactored into three separate fields.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly maps to the Account number box on the form.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd maps directly to the CORRECTED checkbox at the top of the form.

void.rationale: No VoidInd or equivalent element is present in the candidate list for the VOID checkbox; no reasonable match exists.

second_tin_notice.rationale: No SecondTINNoticeInd or equivalent element for the 2nd TIN Not. checkbox is present in the candidate list; no reasonable match exists.

fatca_filing_requirement.rationale: FATCAFilingRequirementInd directly maps to the FATCA filing requirement checkbox on the form.

box_1_interest_income.rationale: InterestIncomeAmt maps directly to Box 1 — Interest income.

box_2_early_withdrawal_penalty.rationale: EarlyWithdrawalPenaltyAmt maps directly to Box 2 — Early withdrawal penalty.

box_3_us_savings_bonds_treasury_interest.rationale: USSavingsBondsTreasObligIntAmt maps directly to Box 3 — Interest on U.S. Savings Bonds and Treasury obligations.

box_4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt maps directly to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

box_5_investment_expenses.rationale: InvestmentExpenseAmt maps directly to Box 5 — Investment expenses.

box_6_foreign_tax_paid.rationale: ForeignTaxesPaidAmt maps directly to Box 6 — Foreign tax paid.

box_7_foreign_country_or_us_possession.rationale: ForeignCountryOrUSPossessionCd maps directly to Box 7 — Foreign country or U.S. possession.

box_8_tax_exempt_interest.rationale: TaxExemptInterestAmt maps directly to Box 8 — Tax-exempt interest.

box_9_specified_private_activity_bond_in.rationale: SpcfdPrvtActyBondInterestAmt maps directly to Box 9 — Specified private activity bond interest.

box_10_market_discount.rationale: MarketDiscountAmt maps directly to Box 10 — Market discount.

box_11_bond_premium.rationale: BondPremiumAmt maps directly to Box 11 — Bond premium.

box_12_bond_premium_on_treasury_obligati.rationale: TreasuryObligBondPremiumAmt maps directly to Box 12 — Bond premium on Treasury obligations.

box_13_bond_premium_on_tax_exempt_bond.rationale: TaxExemptBondPremiumAmt maps directly to Box 13 — Bond premium on tax-exempt bond.

box_14_tax_exempt_and_tax_credit_bond_cu.rationale: TaxExemptTaxCreditBondCUSIPNum maps directly to Box 14 — Tax-exempt and tax credit bond CUSIP number.

box_15_state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under Form1099INTStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 15 — State abbreviation in the state tax withholding section.

box_16_state_identification_number.rationale: StateIdNum under Form1099INTStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 16 — State identification number.

box_17_state_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099INTStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 17 — State tax withheld.
